thread.title: Netflix Poised To Boost Sales By Avoiding ‘Apple Tax’

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Netflix Poised To Boost Sales By Avoiding ‘Apple Tax’
text:
An effort by Netflix ( NFLX ) to bypass the Apple ( AAPL ) App Store for selling subscriptions could provide a noticeable lift to its revenue, a Wall Street firm said Thursday.
X Macquarie Capital estimates that Netflix could see a 1% boost to its 2019 revenue if all future Apple device sign-ups move to its own channel rather than use the App Store. The increased revenue would fall directly to Netflix's bottom line, Macquarie said in a report.
Netflix is testing the removal of iOS sign-ups in 33 international markets, TechCrunch reported Tuesday .
Until Sept. 30, new or lapsed subscribers in markets in Europe, Latin America and Asia will be unable to pay for the internet television service using Apple's iTunes payment method, TechCrunch said. Those customers are instead getting redirected to log payment details directly with Netflix on the web.

It takes a 15% commission on subscriptions maintained for over a year. Critics refer to the fees as an "Apple tax."
Alphabet 's ( GOOGL ) Google Play Store charges the same rates. But Netflix turned off the ability to sign up for subscriptions through Google Play in May, Macquarie said.
App Store Economics Under Pressure Netflix joins streaming music service Spotify ( SPOT ) and "Fortnite" publisher Epic Games in trying to circumvent app store commissions.
The app store business model is facing growing regulatory, legal and competitive pressures, Macquarie said.
Netflix stock dipped 1.5% to 339.17 on the stock market today . It is currently ranked No. 21 on the IBD 50 list of top-performing growth stocks.
